Sara Patel: FYI a support ticket from acme reported a spike in provisional tokens during a streaming retry + toolcall truncation. Suspect race between provisional write + resume duplication.
Drew Wallace: Can you paste the minimal trace?
Sara Patel: trace=tr_acme_01. Steps: stream start -> provisional ledger write -> toolcall invoked -> tool returned truncated result -> router retried to next model -> resumed stream with overlapping prefix -> provisional written again.
Maya Singh: We currently dedupe on final confirmation using end-of-stream marker. If the client reconnects before confirmation we get 2 provisional entries. Our reconciler later collapses them but console shows the spike.
Drew Wallace: Proposal A: add a short TTL on provisional visibility in the console (e.g., hide spikes < 30s) so customers don't get alarmed. Proposal B: add stronger dedupe keys so ledger can merge at write time.
Sara Patel: For dedupe keys I'd include: (stable_session_token || client_session_id || trace_id), toolcall_id if present, prefix_hash, and route_version.
Maya Singh: We don't currently carry a stable_session_token across handoffs. Router assigns ephemeral shard ids. Could we carry a client-provided session id? Backcompat concerns.
Drew Wallace: Alternative: generate a stable_id in the edge gateway when stream_start arrives and propagate it as handoff header X-Session-Stable. That avoids touching client-facing proto but requires all proxies to pass it through.
Maya Singh: Edge-generated stable id is safest ops-wise. Emit telemetry event `session.stable_assigned` at edge. Ledger writes provisional with that id.
Sara Patel: For toolcall truncation we need to ensure toolcall_id is part of provisional key. If toolcall restarts and returns a shorter prefix we might re-emit tokens. Make ledger id = concat(stable_id, toolcall_id, prefix_start).
Drew Wallace: Rollout plan: 1) ledger dedupe acceptance by (stable_id, toolcall_id, prefix_start) but fall back to (trace_id, prefix_hash) if stable_id missing. 2) Edge emits stable_id header behind a feature flag. 3) Router/proxies pass header. 4) Console change to gray provisional entries until confirmed for 60s.
Maya Singh: Tests: add an integration test harness that simulates: mid-stream toolcall timeout -> fallback route -> resume with overlapping prefix. Assert provisional ledger has one entry and confirmed final charge matches single-run accounting.
Sara Patel: Telemetry: add counters `accounting.provisional_write`, `accounting.provisional_dedupe`, `accounting.provisional_confirm` with tags stable_id, route, model, toolcall. Dashboards should show provisional_dedupe rate to verify effect.
ops-bot: Canary scheduled: group=eng-platform env=canary at 1720101300 by Drew Wallace
billing-bot: Created provisional charge pc_acme_01 amount=0.45 tokens=1200 session=ses_edge_77 trace=tr_acme_01
Drew Wallace: If we do edge-generated stable_id we need to handle clients that intentionally rotate ids (e.g., multiple tabs). Should be okay since stable_id is per stream start.
Maya Singh: Backwards compat: ledger accepts stable_id optional. If missing, reconciler heuristics run. We'll log `accounting.stable_id_missing` for last 24h to track coverage.
Sara Patel: UX: Console message copy: "Provisional charges are tentative. They may be reconciled in <2m; confirmed charges are final." Also add a small CTA to view traces for provisional spikes.
Drew Wallace: Ops note: suppress billing alert thresholds on spikes tagged `stable_id_missing` for 1hr during rollout.
Maya Singh: I'll draft a PR for ledger dedupe and the reconciler job to mark suspected duplicates. ETA PR tomorrow.
Sara Patel: I'll own the console copy + feature flag and coordinate with product. ETA Thurs.
Drew Wallace: I'll wire the edge header in two-phase rollout: feature flag on for canary, then gradual. I'll also add a smoke test.
ops-bot: Canary run completed at 1720101345. Logs uploaded to /canary/1720101345/logs.
billing-bot: Alert suppressed for tr_acme_01 per request of Drew Wallace
Sara Patel: Great, re-open if repro happens after changes. Thanks all.
